import contextlib

import root_launcher as r


class WrapperRevisionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.stack = contextlib.ExitStack()
        self.addCleanup(self.stack.close)
        self.closed = []
        self.stack.enter_context(mock.patch.object(r.os, 'close', side_effect=self.closed.append))
        for name in ('posix_spawn', 'pidfd_open', 'waitid', 'waitpid', 'kill'):
            self.stack.enter_context(mock.patch.object(r.os, name, side_effect=AssertionError('unmocked ' + name)))
        for name in ('pthread_sigmask', 'signal', 'setitimer'):
            self.stack.enter_context(mock.patch.object(r.signal, name, return_value=set()))
        self.signals = self.stack.enter_context(mock.patch.object(r.signal, 'pidfd_send_signal'))
        self.stack.enter_context(mock.patch.object(r.time, 'monotonic', return_value=101))
        self.stack.enter_context(mock.patch.object(r.select, 'select', return_value=([], [], [])))
        self.events = []

    def child(self):
        return r.DirectCommand(42, pidfd=142, signal_authority=True)

    def exited(self, code=0):
        return SimpleNamespace(si_pid=42, si_code=os.CLD_EXITED, si_status=code)

    def test_pidfd_failure_keeps_original_slot_and_never_falls_back(self):
        slot = r.OriginalSlot()
        with mock.patch.object(r.os, 'posix_spawn', return_value=42), \
             mock.patch.object(r.os, 'pidfd_open', side_effect=OSError('mock open failure')):
            child = r.spawn_fixed(19, slot)
        self.assertIs(slot.child, child)
        self.assertIsNone(child.pidfd)
        self.assertFalse(child.reaped)
        self.assertIn('open failure', child.setup_error)
        with mock.patch.object(r.os, 'waitid', return_value=self.exited()), \
             mock.patch.object(r.os, 'waitpid', return_value=(42, 0)):
            with self.assertRaises(r.Refused):
                r.monitor_fixed(child, 18, 100, bytearray(), self.events.append)
            self.assertTrue(r.dispose_wrapper(child, None, 100, bytearray(), self.events.append))
        self.signals.assert_not_called()
        self.assertTrue(child.reaped)

    def test_pending_alarm_after_spawn_keeps_original_slot(self):
        slot = r.OriginalSlot()
        with mock.patch.object(r.os, 'posix_spawn', return_value=42), \
             mock.patch.object(r.os, 'pidfd_open', return_value=142), \
             mock.patch.object(r.signal, 'pthread_sigmask', side_effect=[set(), r.Refused('pending alarm')]):
            with self.assertRaises(r.Refused):
                r.spawn_fixed(19, slot)
        self.assertEqual(slot.child.pidfd, 142)
        self.assertFalse(slot.child.reaped)

    def test_early_exit_retires_before_original_sole_reap(self):
        child = self.child()
        def reap(pid, flags):
            self.assertEqual((pid, flags), (42, os.WNOHANG))
            self.assertTrue(child.retired)
            self.assertFalse(child.signal_authority)
            self.assertIsNone(child.pidfd)
            self.assertEqual(self.closed, [142])
            return 42, 0
        with mock.patch.object(r.os, 'waitid', return_value=self.exited()) as wait, \
             mock.patch.object(r.os, 'waitpid', side_effect=reap):
            self.assertTrue(r.dispose_wrapper(child, None, 100, bytearray(), self.events.append))
        wait.assert_called_once_with(os.P_PID, 42, os.WEXITED | os.WNOHANG | os.WNOWAIT)
        self.signals.assert_not_called()
        with self.assertRaises(r.Refused):
            r.emergency_wrapper_signal(child, self.events.append)
        with self.assertRaises(r.Refused):
            r.peek_reap_command(child)

    def test_timeout_signals_only_retained_wrapper_then_reaps_always_intervention(self):
        child = self.child()
        with mock.patch.object(r.time, 'monotonic', return_value=728.1), \
             mock.patch.object(r.os, 'waitid', side_effect=[None, self.exited()]), \
             mock.patch.object(r.os, 'waitpid', return_value=(42, 0)):
            with self.assertRaises(r.Refused):
                r.monitor_fixed(child, 18, 100, bytearray(), self.events.append)
            self.assertTrue(r.dispose_wrapper(child, None, 100, bytearray(), self.events.append))
        self.signals.assert_called_once_with(142, r.signal.SIGKILL, None, 0)
        self.assertTrue(child.intervention)
        self.assertFalse(self.events[-1]['O_N_teardown_proved_by_R'])

    def test_failed_signal_still_confirms_original_exit(self):
        child = self.child()
        self.signals.side_effect = ProcessLookupError('mock ESRCH')
        with mock.patch.object(r.os, 'waitid', side_effect=[None, self.exited()]), \
             mock.patch.object(r.os, 'waitpid', return_value=(42, 0)):
            self.assertTrue(r.dispose_wrapper(child, None, 100, bytearray(), self.events.append))
        self.assertTrue(child.intervention)
        self.assertTrue(any(e['type'] == 'R-signal-error' for e in self.events))

    def test_no_pidfd_survivor_unknown_by30_without_signal(self):
        child = r.DirectCommand(42, setup_error='open denied')
        tick = [728.0]
        def now():
            tick[0] += .2
            return tick[0]
        with mock.patch.object(r.time, 'monotonic', side_effect=now), \
             mock.patch.object(r.os, 'waitid', return_value=None):
            self.assertFalse(r.dispose_wrapper(child, None, 100, bytearray(), self.events.append))
        self.signals.assert_not_called()
        self.assertFalse(child.reaped)
        self.assertIn('unconfirmed', self.events[-1]['unknown'])

        child = self.child()
        with mock.patch.object(r.time, 'monotonic', return_value=730):
            self.assertFalse(r.dispose_wrapper(child, None, 100, bytearray(), self.events.append))
        self.signals.assert_not_called()
        self.assertEqual(self.closed, [142])

    def test_output_errors_during_disposal_do_not_skip_original_wait(self):
        for failure in ('select', 'read'):

                 mock.patch.object(r.os, 'waitid', side_effect=[None, self.exited()]), \
                 mock.patch.object(r.os, 'waitpid', return_value=(42, 0)), \
                 mock.patch.object(r.select, 'select', side_effect=OSError('bad select') if failure == 'select' else None,
                                   return_value=([18], [], [])), \
                 mock.patch.object(r.os, 'read', side_effect=OSError('bad read')):
                self.assertTrue(r.dispose_wrapper(child, 18, 100, bytearray(), self.events.append))
            self.assertTrue(child.reaped)

    def test_reap_status_survives_pending_alarm_after_reap(self):
        child = self.child()
        with mock.patch.object(r.os, 'waitid', return_value=self.exited()), \
             mock.patch.object(r.os, 'waitpid', return_value=(42, 0)), \
             mock.patch.object(r.signal, 'pthread_sigmask', side_effect=[set(), r.Refused('pending deadline')]):
            self.assertTrue(r.dispose_wrapper(child, None, 100, bytearray(), self.events.append))
        self.assertEqual(child.raw_status, 0)
        self.assertTrue(child.retired)
        self.assertTrue(child.reaped)
        self.signals.assert_not_called()

    def orchestration(self, mode):
        child = self.child()
        if mode == 'pidfd-failure':
            child.pidfd, child.signal_authority, child.setup_error = None, False, 'mock open failure'
        before = {'scope': {'fixed': True}, 'uid1001_processes': [], 'mountinfo_sha256': 'same'}
        def spawn(_fd, slot):
            slot.child = child
            if mode == 'post-spawn-error':
                raise r.Refused('pending alarm after spawn')
            return child
        def monitor(c, fd, anchor, output, record):
            if mode == 'pidfd-failure':
                return real_monitor(c, fd, anchor, output, record)
            if mode == 'overflow':
                with mock.patch.object(r.select, 'select', return_value=([fd], [], [])), \
                     mock.patch.object(r.os, 'read', return_value=b'x' * (r.MAX_COMMAND_OUTPUT + 1)):
                    return real_monitor(c, fd, anchor, output, record)
            if mode == 'output-error':
                with mock.patch.object(r.select, 'select', return_value=([fd], [], [])), \
                     mock.patch.object(r.os, 'read', side_effect=OSError('mock output error')):
                    return real_monitor(c, fd, anchor, output, record)
            if mode == 'timeout':
                with mock.patch.object(r.time, 'monotonic', return_value=729):
                    return real_monitor(c, fd, anchor, output, record)
            raise r.Refused('unexpected mode')
        real_monitor = r.monitor_fixed
        sink = mock.mock_open()
        with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
            for name, value in [('review_gate', None), ('sole_parent_gate', None), ('verify_sources', {}),
                                ('snapshot', before), ('prepare_fresh', None), ('write_anchor', None)]:
                stack.enter_context(mock.patch.object(r, name, return_value=value))
            stack.enter_context(mock.patch.object(r, 'spawn_fixed', side_effect=spawn))
            stack.enter_context(mock.patch.object(r, 'monitor_fixed', side_effect=monitor))
            stack.enter_context(mock.patch.object(r.os, 'pipe2', return_value=(18, 19)))
            stack.enter_context(mock.patch.object(r.os, 'set_blocking'))
            stack.enter_context(mock.patch.object(r.os, 'waitid', side_effect=[None, self.exited()]))
            def reap(pid, _flags):
                self.assertNotIn(18, self.closed, 'outputs closed before original confirmation')
                return pid, 0
            stack.enter_context(mock.patch.object(r.os, 'waitpid', side_effect=reap))
            stack.enter_context(mock.patch('builtins.open', sink))
            self.assertFalse(r.run_reviewed_path())
        self.assertTrue(child.reaped)
        if mode == 'pidfd-failure':
            self.assertFalse(child.intervention)
            self.assertCountEqual(self.closed, [19, 18])
            self.signals.assert_not_called()
        else:
            self.assertTrue(child.intervention)
            self.assertCountEqual(self.closed, [19, 142, 18])
            self.signals.assert_called_once_with(142, r.signal.SIGKILL, None, 0)
        data = ''.join(c.args[0] for c in sink().write.call_args_list)
        self.assertIn('"ok": false', data)
        self.assertIn('"raw_status": 0', data)

    def test_actual_orchestration_output_error_uses_bounded_disposal(self):
        self.orchestration('output-error')

    def test_actual_orchestration_pidfd_failure_confirms_without_signal_and_fails(self):
        self.orchestration('pidfd-failure')

    def test_actual_orchestration_overflow_uses_bounded_disposal(self):
        self.orchestration('overflow')

    def test_actual_orchestration_timeout_uses_bounded_disposal(self):
        self.orchestration('timeout')

    def test_actual_orchestration_post_spawn_exception_uses_retained_slot(self):
        self.orchestration('post-spawn-error')

    def test_only_fixed_deadline_configuration_is_exported(self):
        plan = r.plan()
        self.assertEqual(plan['shared_anchor_cutoffs_seconds'], [600, 610, 620, 625, 630])
        self.assertEqual(plan['product_default_cutoffs_seconds'], [26, 28, 30])
        self.assertEqual(plan['runtime_enabled'], 'fixed request once only')

    unittest.main()
